author: Ainy Cormac
description:
Calum Lott’s Immortal Aberration is a carnage-laden and action-packed novella full of guns, guts and glory. In what is perhaps his most grim, dark and chaotic work yet, Immortal Aberration returns us to the Valsollas galaxy and does not hold back. Just looking at the cover by John Devlin should have you drooling by now. […]
